shared_elements: low-relief human figures shown in profile
figures placed to either side of a tree
figures with raised or extended arms holding objects
justification: Both surfaces show bearded human figures carved in profile low relief, arranged in relation to a formalized, densely patterned tree motif, with human figures on either side of that tree and horizontal register bands structuring the field. The decisive differences are that A is a rigidly symmetrical heraldic panel of large winged attendants flanking a single central tree above an inscription band, whereas B is a multi-register processional frieze of small repeated figures walking one way, some leading animals, with the tree merely acting as a divider.
